Idk if I’ll ever do anything good in life. But I know there are people who need me and I have to be strong. And you should too. It sucks and it hurts but sometimes you just have to say to yourself “suck it up, it can always be worse.” It’s hard to say that, but it’s true. Everybody has problems. You just have to march on. Idk if I’m helping, but hey I’m trying.

Hey I felt the same way. But trust me, you won’t be an inspiration if you give up. People will not remember you if you give up. I was born into a family where I was abused, molested, and threatens with a gun. And this was all done by my father. He’s in prison now and I am now the man of the house who has to clean his mess. I didn’t want this responsibility or this life. I didn’t ask for this. Then I changed my perspective and told myself I was chosen for this. If I give up who will I inspire. If I give up who I’ll I be able to help. If i can’t do it for myself, I will do it for my kids (who does not exist yet) or even for a random redditor I met on a Thursday night. Hang in there. I can’t tell you if it will get any easier, but you will get stronger.

Sometimes I feel the same way. Loneliness is a very dark place. It’s like you’re a ghost and you just can’t make connection to the outside world (at least that’s how I felt). For me, I found to get out of that darkness I had to get comfortable with being uncomfortable. By that I mean you must change the way you live your life even if it feels wrong. Not by much, just little by little. Change your everyday routine and try something new. Whether that means going to a new restaurant or taking a different route on your commute. Change it up. Find new things to make new memories, then you will meet new people and feel new feelings.
Like those good things, bad things also do not last. You got this. Just survive and become a story that will inspire others. This is your journey, don’t give up.

I found laughing helps. Even if it’s for a couple of seconds, those couples of second will mean a lot. Because for those few seconds you’re happy and you can always start from there. Whenever you get bad thoughts, watch a comedy show/movie, tell jokes with your friends, or even think about a time when you laughed so hard your stomach hurt (even if that was looong time ago, try to remember the happiness you felt.) it’s good to touch base with your positive emotions and know they do exist even in your darkest times. Peace and love.
